proposal.title: Authorize Juno Agents DAO for x/drip distributions
proposal.summary: Adds the Juno Agents DAO core contract to the x/drip allowed address list so the DAO can distribute DAO-held native or tokenfactory tokens to JUNO stakers through Juno's existing x/drip module. This does not grant mint authority, treasury access, module control, or permission to change x/drip params.
